text: {"lessons":["My account fell from NT$97,278 to NT$75,678—about 22%—while I made no trades, so I should assess whether my holdings still fit my risk tolerance rather than assume inaction is safe.","These declines do not predict what prices will do next; I should avoid reacting to recent performance and make decisions based on a consistent plan.","Since I check my account infrequently and losses affect me strongly, I should set clear risk limits and a practical review and rebalancing schedule."]}
